capabilities: render in-progress and won't-do task items in reader and live preview
generate a TODO.md file by scanning task lists in markdown files
configure the generated filename and which task types are included
exclude files or folders from the task scan via marker comments or an .exclude_todos file
extras: The README includes maintainer-facing release workflow instructions (GitHub Actions) that are irrelevant to users.
intentEvidence: Extended reader view support for task lists, including in-progress and won't do task items.
problem: Obsidian task lists only render done and not-done checkboxes, and there is no built-in way to mark tasks as in progress or skipped, or to aggregate tasks across files into one list.
summary: Renders in-progress and won't-do task list items with custom styling and generates a TODO.md summary of all tasks in the vault.
